The '''Finance Council''' was a council of the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|New Republic Senate]]. The Finance Council had oversight and budgeting authority over the [[Ministry of Finance (New Republic)|Ministry of Finance]].<ref name="CTD">''[[Cracken's Threat Dossier]]''</ref>
